rationale: Class 2 row-level rate defect. The source SOI header maps the cited rate cells to Cash Interest Rate and PIK. The flagged rows disclose a 3.00% cash interest rate plus a separate PIK leg (7.00% for Delta Leasing, 6.00% for Establishment Labs).
